stdout:
Update a third-party link. Use this tool to update the status or type of a link between a YouTube channel and a third-party service.

Usage:
  yutu thirdPartyLink update [flags]

Examples:
# Update a third-party link status
yutu thirdPartyLink update --linkingToken abc123 --linkStatus linked --parts snippet,status
# Update a third-party link type
yutu thirdPartyLink update --linkingToken abc123 --type channelToStoreLink --parts snippet,status

Flags:
  -e, --externalChannelId string   Channel ID to which changes should be applied, for delegation
  -h, --help                       help for update
  -s, --linkStatus string          Status of the link: unknown|failed|pending|linked
  -l, --linkingToken string        Linking token that identifies the YouTube account and channel
  -o, --output string              json|yaml|silent
  -p, --parts strings              Comma separated parts (default [snippet,status])
  -t, --type string                Type of the link: linkUnspecified|channelToStoreLink
      --yes                        Confirm the operation
